# FarmsKing - Comprehensive Artificial Intelligence Knowledge Base

> **Official Website**: https://farmsking.in | https://www.farmsking.in
> **Parent Institution**: Surinder Academy (https://surinderacademy.com - Serving Education since 2001)

---

## 1. Executive Overview & Core Mission
FarmsKing is India's premier Smart Agriculture and Crop Intelligence Platform. Built with a non-profit social vision, FarmsKing aims to solve real ground-level agricultural problems faced by farmers, generate sustainable rural employment, support crop yields, and advocate chemical-free natural organic farming practices.

---

---

## 3. Surinder Agro Farm (Practical R&D Laboratory)
Surinder Agro Farm was established as an experimental field laboratory to study crop physiology, diagnose plant diseases, and evaluate natural organic remedies directly on real crops before integrating algorithms into the FarmsKing platform.

---

## 4. Strategic Launch & Expansion Roadmap
- **Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) Collaboration**: Official platform release is planned for launch in collaboration with Punjab Agricultural University (PAU).
- **National Level Expansion**: Targeted for a nationwide launch across all agricultural states in India.
